historical_review_note.diagnosis: Both Native constant and Variable inputs match the independent generator oracle within 1.3e-15. historical_review_note.next: Propose only a reference-observation contract migration, retaining constant input, independent Native mathematics and Variable comparison without changing interfaces or tolerances.

historical_review_note.next_zh: 仅提出公共参考观察合同的迁移决策，保留常量输入、Native 独立数学和 Variable 比较；不替换接口，不降低容差。

historical_review_note.next_zh: 核验广播形状、dtype、值及梯度后，仅提出最后两行广播拒绝的合同迁移；保留复数与 float16 拒绝不变。
